name: scream
notes: Raw shriek: a ragged bile-green waveform crescent 62 px tall (wild at mid-height, calm at the tips) with a dark-olive wake band, two ragged echoes catching up, a light haze quiver, bile streaks streaming back, marsh-water droplets and mud clods torn up at its foot. Chest-high: roll through it. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 67; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 99; place that point on the ring's position.
